Chart #41 requires explicit Portfolio TARGET / common Security identity / user-defined Strategy Theme source-owner claims and immutable returns. Main is the coordination writer; it is not an inferred source owner. User-approved CDR-027 permits this one observed-session bounded routing cycle under CDR-024 v1.1.

[Exact return contract](https://github.com/kco994553-star/Investment-System1/blob/2cda490a93bd2c093ff07557af4fe748964c20c1/implementation/docs/coordination/evidence/main_chart_owner_cycle_2026-10-06/OWNER_RETURN_CONTRACT.md) · [owner/source intake](https://github.com/kco994553-star/Investment-System1/blob/2cda490a93bd2c093ff07557af4fe748964c20c1/implementation/docs/coordination/evidence/main_chart_owner_cycle_2026-10-06/SOURCE_OWNER_INTAKE.json). Current Chart HEAD: `2a0a2d278d4e61ba694ac545792ab17c1a4cdcb9`; canonical `b8e39a2196a6d7794a04a0cd5393c68329e126ca`.

No receiving source Work/session, source branch/write-set or accepted source-owner claim was found in current refs, issues, Global ledger or Personal handoff. Preserve **OWNER_UNASSIGNED** until an actual role/session receipt is returned; the common GitHub login is not proof.

| Required role | Proposed new branch (not created/reserved/accepted) | Proposed bounded evidence write-set |
|---|---|---|
| Portfolio TARGET source owner | owner/portfolio-target-return-v1 | implementation/docs/portfolio_target_owner/** |
| Common Security identity source owner | owner/security-map19-return-v1 | implementation/docs/security_map19_owner/** |
| User-defined Strategy Theme source owner | owner/strategy-theme-return-v1 | implementation/docs/strategy_theme_owner/** |

A receiving Work must confirm its accountable role/session, actual branch+HEAD, exact write-set, absence of conflicting writer/lease, immutable returned paths/hashes and source/adoption authority. A different existing owner branch is acceptable only with its actual claim; no existing scope is transferred by this issue.

Return A-S1 current TARGET root/version/19 rows/cash/Decimal denominator/completeness/provenance/effective and separately evidenced availability; A-S2 all19 common Security/share-form mappings with reviewed CompanyLink and C-25 preserved; A-S3 root/security-bound Theme catalog/version and19 assignments. Existing authored 30/25/20/25 values are reference evidence, not current source admission; document date and Git/extraction time are not substituted for effective/availability time. No source IDs, security IDs, clock, authority or grant may be synthesized to fill a slot.

TARGET ≠ ACTUAL. GICS / Strategy Theme / Investment Type / Overlap remain separate. Market bars, ACTUAL accounts, GICS or investment-type assignment are not additional TARGET prerequisites. Existing Personal/identity Frozen contracts stay unchanged. Global writes are Main-only; receiving owner uses only its accepted own branch/scope.

Delivery of this issue does not prove owner receipt, automatic execution, source admission or any gate closure. Canonical merge, Official/LIVE, Holdout, PIT relaxation, destructive history/evidence, credentials/paid resources/financial operations are prohibited. Current six gates remain OPEN.
